chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Isma'il ibn Marrar, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said:

There are five things without which one will not find much satisfaction. It was asked: What are they, O son of the Messenger of God? He said: Religion, intellect, modesty, beautiful character, and beautiful manners.
And there are five things without which one will not find comfort in living: health, security, wealth, contentment, and an agreeable companion.

key_terms.الأنيس الموافق: Agreeable companion -- a compatible and harmonious friend or associate
key_terms.القناعة: Contentment -- being satisfied with what one has, a key Islamic virtue
key_terms.حسن الأدب: Beautiful manners -- learned etiquette and refined conduct
key_terms.حسن الخلق: Beautiful character -- innate moral disposition and good nature
key_terms.مستمتع: Satisfaction, enjoyment -- refers to finding fulfillment and benefit in one's qualities

ai.seo_question: What are the five things needed for satisfaction and five things needed for a comfortable life according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) taught that a fulfilling life requires two sets of five qualities. The first set -- religion, intellect, modesty, good character, and good manners -- relates to inner virtues that bring spiritual satisfaction. The second set -- health, security, wealth, contentment, and a compatible companion -- relates to external conditions necessary for a comfortable worldly life. This teaching was given in response to a question from one of his students, reflecting the Imam's holistic view of human well-being.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father (rh) narrated to us from Ibrahim b. Hashim from Isma`il b. Marrar from Yunus b. `Abd al-Rahman from `Abdullah b. Sinan from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:

There are five things without which one will not find much satisfaction. It was said: What are they, O son of the Messenger of Allah? He said: (1) religion, (2) intellect, (3) modesty, (4) beautiful character, and (5) beautiful manners.
There are also five things without which one will not find livelihood: (1) health, (2) security, (3) needlessness, (4) contentment, and (5) amiable correspondence.
